run_origin: Existing TRX50 remote-verify.py run, not a complete end-to-end run of the newly published verify.sh wrapper

build_events.extraction: All batch_committed, command_finished and run_finished events; selected time/result/count fields only. Command arguments, setup-cleanup events and resource samples are omitted. This is a projection, not the full original event stream.

scope: Compilation and five endpoint axiom checks only. No independent kernel replay or challenge comparison was performed by this run.
checksum_note: SHA256SUMS covers the published evidence files in this directory. It checks file integrity, not mathematical correctness. Log origin_sha256 values refer to the whole original log, including bytes omitted from a tail excerpt.
